verdict.rationale: Isaac Sim runs on your own infrastructure: the docs cover running it in Docker for repeatable setups and composing it from pip-installable Python packages, and its source is on GitHub. Isaac Lab is open source with standalone headless operation from workstation to data center, and community discussion independently confirms GR00T N1 was released under Apache 2. Missing for 10: hands-on or independent reports of self-hosting Isaac Sim itself, and documentation of hardware or licensing terms for on-prem deployment.
